title: Logical access controls restrict unauthorized access
text: The entity implements logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures to protect information assets from unauthorized access, including authentication and authorization checks on every entry point.

title: Restrict access via encryption and boundary protections
text: The entity implements boundary protection systems and encrypts sensitive data to restrict unauthorized access to system resources and data in transit.

title: Monitor system components for anomalies
text: The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of security events, and logging must not itself leak sensitive data such as credentials or cardholder data.

title: Restrict transmission, movement, and removal of information
text: The entity restricts the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized users and processes; secrets must be sourced from a managed store, not hardcoded.
